ctaHeading: Ready for Your Melbourne Home Extension?
aboutText: Home Extensions Melbourne has been providing top-notch carpentry and maintenance services to the Melbourne community for over a decade. Our skilled team specialises in home extensions, decking, renovations, and more, ensuring every project is completed to the highest standards. We are committed to enhancing your living space with durable and aesthetically pleasing solutions tailored to your needs.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive carpentry services in Melbourne, from home extensions to decking and renovations. Our experienced team handles both minor repairs and major projects, ensuring quality workmanship and timely completion.

services.title: Home Extensions
services.desc: We specialise in creating custom home extensions that seamlessly integrate with your existing structure, adding value and space to your Melbourne home.

services.title: Decking & Pergolas
services.desc: Create beautiful outdoor areas with quality timber decking and pergola installations, perfect for Melbourne's climate and lifestyle.

services.title: Renovations
services.desc: Transform your bathroom and laundry spaces with professional renovation services, enhancing functionality and style in your Melbourne property.

services.title: Weatherboards & Fascia
services.desc: Upgrade your home's exterior with durable weatherboard and fascia replacements, protecting and beautifying Melbourne homes.

services.title: Carpentry Services
services.desc: From structural repairs to custom builds, we provide expert carpentry solutions for all your Melbourne home improvement needs.

services.title: Painting & Timber Flooring
services.desc: Enhance your interiors with specialised painting and elegant timber flooring installations, adding a touch of sophistication to Melbourne homes.
